actions.name: duergar resilience
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being &reference[charmed apply=false] or &reference[paralyzed apply=false].

actions.name: enlarge
actions.desc: For [[lookup @labels.duration activity=Zf6mfw7MGBJxkegq]], the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

actions.name: invisibility
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically turns &reference[invisible] until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to [[lookup @labels.duration activity=1wj57M6m7yuqQhtN]] (as if concentrating on a spell).

actions.name: sunlight sensitivity
actions.desc: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: war pick
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage 1d8 + @abilities.str.mod piercing average extended]], or [[/damage 2d8 + @abilities.str.mod piercing average]] damage while enlarged.

actions.name: javelin
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage 1d6 + @abilities.str.mod piercing average extended]], or [[/damage 2d6 + @abilities.str.mod piercing average]] damage while enlarged.
